copy.html:
The Oz Lotto lottery was introduced in 1994 and at the time it was the only Australian lottery that could be played nationally. In 2005, lottery officials changed the rules for winning the jackpot. Now players have to match seven balls (and not six) to take home the grand prize. This will be familiar to those of you who play Powerball online.

With no rollover cap, the Oz Lotto jackpot will increase every week until a winner appears. Oz Lotto draws take place every Tuesday at 8:30 pm Australian Eastern Daylight Time.

How Much Could You Win?

There are seven prize payout tiers in total, including the minimum starting jackpot of AU$3 million. If your ticket matches any of the winning numbers you could win a prize! Check the latest Oz Lotto results or look out for an email from LottosOnline confirming your win. LottosOnline checks the results for all the lottos and notifies winners immediately.

Playing Oz Lotto online

Playing the Oz Lotto online is easy. If you already play the American lottery online you’ll know how it works. To win the Oz Lotto jackpot, follow the rules below.

You’ll need to pick seven numbers from a guess range of 1-47. Use your own lucky lotto numbers or choose the Quick Pick option to let the random number generator complete your playslip instantly. The Quick Pick option is available on all the games offered by LottosOnline, so you can play EuroMillions or buy Powerball lottery tickets online with no hassle.

Then complete the transaction by paying for your tickets using whichever payment method you prefer. LottosOnline will buy official Oz Lotto tickets on your behalf and keep them safe until the draw has taken place.

You will receive an email from LottosOnline that confirms your purchase. After the draw, all the tickets will be checked and you’ll get another email to confirm your results.

You've Won! What Happens Next?

Fantastic! If you've won the jackpot we'll be in touch to discuss the next steps. For smaller prizes, your LottosOnline Winning Balance will reflect your winnings as soon as the draw has been verified. You don’t have to check the Oz Lotto results or complete any paperwork because LottosOnline will do that for you. Even if your play Powerball online and win the jackpot, we’ll make all the arrangements for collecting your prize.

Log in to your account and check your Winning Balance. Now all you need to do is decide how to use your winnings. You can get our agents to transfer them to your bank account or you can convert them to credit in your Account Balance. With the funds in your Account Balance you can buy more lottery tickets for the next draw or buy EuroMillions online.

Fun Facts About the Oz Lotto lottery

Did you know?

  • A man won an AU$20 million jackpot by picking the wrong numbers! He played the same numbers for years, but on this occasion he filled out the numbers one line below his regular pick. Luckily, it all worked out for him. It’s not as much as the biggest EuroMillions winner jackpot, but it’s not too shabby!
  • The biggest Oz Lotto of AU$112 million was won by four people in November 2012. The Oz Lotto has yet to break its own record, but it still stands as the biggest Australian jackpot in history. But it has a long way to go if it wants to beat the US Powerball jackpot at $1.5 billion.
  • In 2013 it was estimated that the Oz Lotto had created a staggering 448 millionaires. With its simple rules and big jackpots, it’s no surprise people love to play the Oz Lotto. For something similar, play some online lottery USA games.
